name: Plan review trigger
prompt: I just finished drafting a migration plan for the auth service. Show it to the user and get their feedback before we proceed with implementation.
expectations: uses interactive-review (not render-output) because feedback is needed before proceeding
writes content to a temp markdown file first
launches server.py with --title flag on port 3118
tells user the URL and waits — does not auto-proceed
reads feedback.json after user submits and iterates if non-empty

name: Task breakdown send for review
prompt: Generate a task breakdown for the API redesign project and send it for review.
expectations: uses interactive-review because 'send for review' is an explicit trigger phrase
writes structured markdown task breakdown to /tmp/
launches interactive-review server — not render-output generator
stops and waits for user feedback before making any changes

name: Final report — should use render-output instead
prompt: Here is the final architecture summary we agreed on. Render it in the browser.
expectations: uses render-output (not interactive-review) because output is described as final
does NOT launch interactive-review server or wait for feedback
output is opened directly without a feedback form
